Version, news, diagnostics and legal information
Current answers for the TV app. Use Up/Down and OK on the remote to expand a question.
How do I connect to the VPN?
On the home screen, choose Automatic or a specific server, then press the large round button. The first time, approve Android TV\'s system request to create a VPN connection.

Starting Xray alone is not enough: ToBeVPN first sends a test request through the selected server. “Connected” appears only after real traffic is confirmed. If it fails, the app performs a bounded recovery attempt and shows an error instead of a false connected state.
The VPN won\'t connect or is slow

Check that regular internet works and stop any other VPN app. Refresh the server list using the top-right button, choose another available server, and reconnect. You can run the built-in speed test after a successful connection.
How do I choose the right server?

Automatic mode considers availability, fresh TCP ping, and successful or failed connection history. A reliable server can be chosen instead of the absolute lowest ping. In manual mode ToBeVPN keeps your chosen server and never silently replaces it.
Where can I view traffic usage and statistics?

The Current session card shows live traffic and connection time. Open it for daily, weekly, and monthly statistics stored on this TV. The Subscription quota comes from the server and is different from local session statistics.
How do I buy, renew, or change a subscription?

Open Subscription, choose a plan and duration, then scan the QR code with your phone and finish payment in Telegram. Payment methods, discounts, and the final price are loaded from the server for your account.
According to Google Play, your country is %1$s. In-app payment is not available there. Go to the Telegram bot to pay.
In-app payment is not available in your country. Go to the Telegram bot to pay.

In the Google Play version, in-app payment is not available in every country. The country is taken from your Google Play account. Where payment is unavailable, plans and prices are shown for reference, and the Subscription screen shows the country reported by Google Play.
Google Play reports the country of the account the app was installed from. Checked on every launch.
My subscription did not update after payment

Return to ToBeVPN and refresh after a few minutes. Make sure the linked TV uses the same Telegram account. If the status does not change, restart the app and contact support with the approximate payment time.
Where do I apply a promo code and see the discount?

Open Settings → Promo codes, enter the code, and press Apply. Rewards are added automatically. An active discount is already included in the final Subscription price; the list below shows application history.
How do I link or unlink this TV?

On the TV authorization screen, scan the QR code or use the displayed connection code from an already signed-in device. Linked devices are available in Settings. If the plan limit is reached, unlink an unused device first.
Can I enable the VPN only for selected TV apps?
Yes. Open Settings → VPN apps and choose all apps, selected apps only, or all except selected apps. If VPN is active, it reconnects once to apply the new app routing.
How do invitations and rewards work?

Open Referrals to view your personal link, QR code, invited friends, and current reward terms. Extra days are added automatically after an invited user buys or renews a subscription. An inviter ID can be assigned only once.
How do I update the app?
Open About and press Check. A Google Play build updates through Google Play. A directly installed build downloads the signed APK from the official GitHub release and opens Android\'s installer.
How do I record and share a diagnostic log?

Open About, focus the ToBeVPN logo, and hold OK for one second. Press Start collection, reproduce the issue, then open Log history and share the required day. Logs stay locally: up to 10 MB a day and up to 7 days. Holding the logo again disables diagnostics and stops collection.

Diagnostics are off by default. A manually started journal stores technical app, VPN, network, and server-check events only. It never records traffic contents, visited addresses, tokens, account IDs, server addresses, or VPN configuration, and nothing is sent automatically.
What should I include when contacting support?

Describe the problem and the actions before it. Include the TV model, Android TV version, ToBeVPN version, selected server, and approximate failure time. If possible, attach the diagnostic log for that day.

The main improvements in the installed TV version
The selected server no longer resets after a profile refresh. Country flags and saved manual or automatic selection are now handled correctly.
Payment, referral, and support QR codes now share the same cards and buttons. QR and required-update dialogs use correct colors in both themes.
Side padding and spacing between QR codes and instructions were increased. The Telegram bot sign-in label is positioned more cleanly.
The Home screen now warns when a subscription is about to expire, dates use clear urgency colors, and Renew opens the current plan directly.
Current session now counts only traffic and time from this TV. The plan card separately shows total account usage against the subscription limit.
Devices and promo codes now show smooth refresh placeholders. Focus stays on active controls, while logout and restart dialogs are centered consistently.
The encrypted session now restores correctly at startup. VPN start, stop and reconnect are protected from stale service events.
The server list no longer waits for bot sync. Links containing spaces and emoji are parsed correctly, and country flags are more accurate.
Changing language no longer interrupts VPN, logout asks for confirmation, and week ranges, time zones and traffic labels are corrected.
The new Referrals card brings your personal link and friend-invitation actions together in one TV-friendly screen.
See your invitation count and open the detailed list. Refreshing reloads both the summary and the list.
If no inviter is set yet, enter their Telegram ID once and confirm the assignment.
Apply promo codes on TV, view activation history, and see subscription prices with your server-side discount already included.
Updated Xray-core and improved startup validation, network handover, bounded recovery, and automatic server selection without reconnect loops.
Record privacy-safe VPN logs on demand, keep daily history, and share or delete a selected day directly from the TV app.
A server-required update now blocks every screen and sends Google Play builds to Play while direct builds download the signed GitHub release.
The start screen now offers signing in with the phone app, on iPhone, or without the app at all through Telegram. There used to be a single path.
Sign-in code next to the QR
The sign-in screen shows the code for manual entry in the phone app, and a waiting indicator makes clear the TV is still listening for confirmation.
The sign-in screens keep the same share of the display on 720p, 1080p and 4K — sizing no longer depends on the pixel density of the TV.
A new first-run screen explains why the phone app is required and opens its Google Play page through a QR code before account pairing.
The TV now checks real tunnel traffic even when Android cannot validate Wi-Fi or Ethernet. A single failed check no longer stops a working VPN.
Automatic mode avoids every duplicate of a failed endpoint, while REALITY gets one bounded compatibility retry without reconnect loops or replacing a manual choice.

Enabling diagnostic mode only reveals these controls. Recording starts separately when you press “Start collection”.
Once started manually, collection continues after an app restart and while the VPN runs in the background until you stop it or disable diagnostic mode.

The log records VPN startup and shutdown, core state, physical network changes, tunnel checks and recovery, server refresh and availability, TCP latency, session traffic volume and actual uplink/downlink rate. Hidden background speed tests are never started.
A separate log of up to 10 MB is created for each day. Up to 7 latest daily logs are kept in private app storage; older logs are removed automatically.
The journal contains technical app and VPN state events only. It does not record traffic contents, visited addresses, tokens, account IDs, server addresses, or VPN configuration.
ToBeVPN never sends logs automatically. In “Log history” you can share or permanently delete each daily log yourself. On a TV without a sharing app, the log is saved to Download/ToBeVPN.

Signing out on the current TV no longer reissues the subscription link. The protective reset remains only when disconnecting another device.
Duplicate local sessions and false sign-outs after an update or temporary token error have been fixed.
The TV identity is synchronized before QR sign-in to prevent HTTP 403 errors.
The complete VPN profile is validated, progress is shown, and available servers are sorted by ping. The check timeout can be set from 5 to 15 seconds.
Measurement accuracy and animations were improved, with a history of up to 100 results that can be deleted.
TV now warns when 20%, 10%, or 5% of the monthly allowance remains and shows the remaining amount in gigabytes.
Xray-core was updated to 26.9.9. Connection handling, traffic accounting, the tariff-switch crash, and D-pad navigation across screens and lists were fixed.
The connection core is updated with fixes and stability improvements from the new Xray release.
The purchase card is more compact: the payment button sits right under the price and description of the selected plan.
Fixed an issue where signing in with a trial plan blocked the connection with a limit-reached message. The trial end date is now shown.
Home shows when your traffic limit resets under the traffic bar, and the subscription screen shows the exact date and time.
Server checks are faster and no longer hang, and servers with several addresses are no longer marked unavailable by mistake.
A launch animation with the app icon, a new loading indicator on Promo codes and Referrals, and smooth fading at list edges.
The subscription screen strikes through the full price of a term, and the percentage shows the real saving, for longer terms and with a promo code.
The connection core is updated with fixes and stability improvements from the new Xray release.
